| where OperationName in ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","Change user password")

          ResetActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
          ResetActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress);

| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where OperationName in ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","User started security info registration","User registered all required security info")
| extend TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)

description: Detects kustomize invoked with --helm-command whose target is a shell/script path rather than helm, matching the Synacktiv Argo CD repo-server RCE.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/unpatched-argo-cd-repo-server-flaw.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/02
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: '--helm-command'
  suspicious:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.sh'
      - '/tmp/'
      - 'bash'
      - 'curl'
      - 'wget'
      - 'python'
  condition: selection and suspicious
level: high
2584.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*--helm-command*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | regex process="--helm-command[=\s]+(?!\S*helm(\s|$))" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2584.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.command_line:*--helm-command* AND (@process.command_line:*.sh* OR @process.command_line:*\/tmp\/* OR @process.command_line:*bash* OR @process.command_line:*curl* OR @process.command_line:*wget* OR @process.command_line:*python*)
2584.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/kustomize/i
| regex("--helm-command", field=CommandLine)
| CommandLine=/--helm-command[=\s]+\S*(\.sh|\/tmp\/|bash|curl|wget|python)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

let SamlBurstThreshold = 50;   // legit users hit /saml/login a few times; 50+ POSTs from ONE external source in 1h fits the length-varying overread fuzz loop
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where DeviceVendor has "Citrix" and DeviceProduct has "NetScaler"
| where RequestURL has "/saml/login"
| where RequestMethod =~ "POST"
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == false   // pre-auth overread is internet-facing; drop internal SSO traffic
| summarize RequestCount = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Appliances = dcount(DestinationIP), SampleUrl = any(RequestURL) by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where RequestCount > SamlBurstThreshold
| order by RequestCount desc
2670.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count as request_count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, dc(Web.dest) as appliance_count from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.uri_path="/saml/login" Web.http_method=POST by Web.src _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where request_count > 50
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - request_count

2749.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Snyk VulnBench JS 1.0: Can LLMs Find the Same Bugs Twice?
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("server.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/app/public/") or FileName in~ ("server.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2749.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Snyk VulnBench JS 1.0: Can LLMs Find the Same Bugs Twice? ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("server.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/var/app/public/*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("server.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
